_description: Rise FC standalone schema operator — expected files contract for output bundle validator. This is a contract schema definition, not a real run artifact. No output bundle has been created.

requiredFiles.description: Top-level manifest for the output bundle. Must conform to OUTPUT_BUNDLE_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_V1_0.json.
Run metadata including schemaProfile, pageRoute, truthFingerprint, and run context. Must conform to RUN_METADATA_SCHEMA_V1_0.json.
Evidence map confirming page content evidence for each emitted schema field. Must conform to EVIDENCE_MAP_SCHEMA_V1_0.json. Must be built from confirmed page content — not invented.
Controller decision record including held field approvals, blocked module confirmation, and decision rationale. Must conform to CONTROLLER_DECISION_SCHEMA_V1_0.json.
Validator results record from the schema validation run. Must conform to VALIDATOR_RESULTS_SCHEMA_V1_0.json.
Human-readable report of all schema fields and modules that were withheld from the output bundle, with reasons.
Human-readable report of all Phase 0 facts that were deferred — not yet emitted — with the reason for deferral.

conditionalFiles.condition: Present when the run produces schema output (jsonLdCreated: true). Must not contain blocked @type values. Must not contain unapproved held properties.
conditionalFiles.note: This file does not exist yet. It will be created in a future governed schema run after all preconditions in 05_REFERENCE_WORKFLOW/ are confirmed.

conditionalFiles.condition: Present when currentWebsiteImplementationAuthorized: true in output_bundle_manifest.json. Requires explicit human approval before production use.
conditionalFiles.note: This file does not exist yet. It will be created after human approval for Mode 1 implementation.

blockedFiles.blockedUntil: Human approval granted and all preconditions in HOMEPAGE_DRAFT_PRECONDITIONS_AND_HOLD_MATRIX_V1_0.md confirmed
blockedFiles.note: The file name is listed in conditionalFiles above. It is also listed here to make clear it must not be created until governed preconditions are met.

safetyConstraints.note: These values represent the current package posture. A future governed run may update schemaOutputCreated and jsonLdCreated to true only after all preconditions are confirmed.
